title: Hanasato Minori — Game Face At The Meeting!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: MORE MORE HOUSE

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Haruka, let's start heading over to the TV station. It's almost time for that meeting.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, it's already that time. Just give me a second to get ready.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We're going to hear from some of the staff from that show we appeared on a little while back, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I know it's going to be tough for just the two of you to go, but good luck...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: In the meantime, we'll keep working on our stream ideas and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thanks.
Then, we'll be going now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Haruka and Saito are doing their best, so we need to keep doing what we can right now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, I totally agree!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We're gonna keep working on stream ideas and do research on that online show, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right. Shizuku and I will continue working on our stream ideas, while you look into that show, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know our workloads are gonna increase while Haruka's gone, but we'll get through this by dividing and conquering!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(How should I start researching...?
Oh, what if I start by looking at any archived footage they have?)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I have to do everything I can right now to help Haruka and Saito...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hmm... I see...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I know a lot more now after watching a few of their old episodes!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (We're being asked to appear in a segment where the guests showcase currently trending artists...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But each guest does it in a different way!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (When that choreographer talked about that singer-dancer ensemble, he passionately talked about their dance routines...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (And when that music producer talked about that idol group, she explained not only their songs, but how they were produced too. I thought that was really interesting.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Someone even left a comment saying, “It's great how each artist is analyzed from a variety of different angles.” And those differences are probably what this show's viewers enjoy so much.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We'll need to keep that in mind.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
And figure out a way to sound unique...
Which means...
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Okay, I've jotted down all the essential bits! Now I just need to—)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hi, Minori. How are things going on your end?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I just finished writing down some notes after watching a few of their past episodes...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, why don't we take a break and share each other's progress? We also just reached a good place to stop.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really?! I'd love to hear more about your ideas!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We've only just completed our basic outlines, but here's mine.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm thinking about doing a follow-up cooking stream. Our last one did really well, so I thought we could turn it into a series.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, everybody loves your cooking streams, Airi, so I bet they'll be thrilled when they hear the news!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks. Now I need to start thinking about what we're going to make.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, Shizuku, how about you?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Mine is also going to be a follow-up like Airi's, but I'm thinking about doing another skincare stream.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: How you take care of your skin changes with the seasons, so I'm hoping to provide our viewers with some suitable tips and options.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sounds good. You're all the rage right now because of your commercial, so I'm sure everyone is going to love getting skincare tips from you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Alright, and here's my report to finish things off! I looked into the show we'll be appearing on, and...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The best part of this segment seems to be how guests showcase the artists, especially any unique remarks they can make.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Unique remarks?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, they all talked about things from their point of view... It's like they were all able to showcase those artists in ways only they knew how!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And everyone watching seems to look forward to hearing what they have to say.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which is why I also wanna show everyone what MORE MORE JUMP! is really about when we do our showcase!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I see. What we're really about...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I also wanna listen to a bunch of songs by the artist we're going to introduce and give good recommendations!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I thought it'd be great if we could put some playlists together and introduce them to everyone! One could be for when you wanna relax, another could be for when you need some encouragement...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I like that since you'd be making good use of your ability to see things from our fans' point of view.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe... It's our first on-screen appearance in a while, so I wanna make sure we make a good impression!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, that's what I like to hear!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, if we're gonna make Minori's plan a reality, we gotta start moving now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, we'll want to ask the director to see if we can get the name of the artist we're gonna be asked to introduce early.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! I'll ask Saito when she gets back.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (We received this offer because of Shizuku's hard work.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Not only that, Haruka is counting on us to do a good job.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (So, I've gotta do everything I can to make sure we keep moving forward!)
